items.title: Democrats prepare to go after Apple, Meta and Elon Musk companies
items.summary: The midterm results handed Congress new investigative powers, and some of the biggest names in tech are already on the list.

items.title: How sustainable is the AI investment boom after Thursday’s selloff?
items.summary: Investing.com -- The artificial intelligence investment boom is becoming increasingly difficult to sustain at its current pace as technology companies pour billions of dollars into infrastructure without a corresponding acceleration in revenues, raising the risk of an eventual spending slowdown that could weigh on economic growth, Capital Economics said.

items.summary: Key TakeawaysPDD shares have fallen 39% over the past year to $83, leaving the stock at just 7. 2x forward earnings.

items.title: Is America’s AI Data Center Boom About to Hit a Brick Wall?
items.summary: AI demand keeps surging, yet former Bitcoin miners are losing nearly half their value in a month. Money is tightening, Texas politicians are circling, and two December dates could decide which data center builders survive.

items.title: Anthropic’s $895 Billion AI Gamble Could Become Wall Street’s Next Debt Nightmare
items.summary: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals a staggering web of contracts, and the companies on the other side are already burning cash to honor them. Six stocks have started to react, and only one is holding up.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Loom With Market Damaged, Big Winners Broken; Apple, Amazon, Microsoft Strong
items.summary: The stock market needs repair while Sandisk and Micron seem broken. Apple, Amazon and Microsoft are holding up. Berkshire earnings fell.

items.title: Anthropic’s $2.5 Trillion IPO Dream Could Be Heading for a $1 Trillion Reality Check
items.summary: Anthropic has no public shares yet, but Amazon, NVIDIA and Microsoft already feel its wobble. Big investors are pushing back on the price, and the fallout could reshape how Wall Street values every dollar of AI spending.
